headword: {運動能力|うんどうのうりょく}

definitions.gloss: athletic ability; physical fitness; motor skills
definitions.explanation: The ability to perform physical activities effectively. Encompasses coordination, speed, strength, endurance, and other physical capabilities.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{運動能力|うんどうのうりょく}が{高|たか}い。
{子供|こども}の{運動能力|うんどうのうりょく}は{年齢|ねんれい}とともに{発達|はったつ}する。
examples.english: Children's motor skills develop with age.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}の{調査|ちょうさ}によると、{子供|こども}たちの{運動能力|うんどうのうりょく}が{低下|ていか}しているそうだ。
examples.english: According to a recent survey, children's physical fitness is reportedly declining.

notes:
A compound of {運動|うんどう} (exercise, movement) and {能力|のうりょく} (ability, capacity). Frequently appears in discussions about sports, education, and child development.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {運動能力|うんどうのうりょく}が{高|たか}い/{低|ひく}い — to have high/low athletic ability
- {運動能力|うんどうのうりょく}が{優|すぐ}れている — to have excellent athletic ability
- {運動能力|うんどうのうりょく}テスト — fitness test
- {運動能力|うんどうのうりょく}の{向上|こうじょう} — improvement of athletic ability
- {運動能力|うんどうのうりょく}の{低下|ていか} — decline in physical fitness

RELATED WORDS:
- {体力|たいりょく} — physical strength/stamina (more about endurance and raw physical power)
- {運動神経|うんどうしんけい} — motor coordination; colloquially used to mean "being good/bad at sports"
- {身体能力|しんたいのうりょく} — physical ability (broader, includes non-sport contexts)

USAGE:
In Japanese schools, students take {体力|たいりょく}テスト ({運動能力|うんどうのうりょく}テスト) — standardized fitness tests measuring grip strength, flexibility, running speed, and other metrics. Results are tracked nationally, and declining scores are a topic of public concern.
